title: Welcome to hackcv
author: hackcv
description: hackcv is an AI-powered news aggregation and summarization platform.
content:
Welcome to hackcv

hackcv is a minimalist, AI-powered news aggregation platform. We help you stay updated with the latest AI and technology news.

Features

  • 🤖 AI-curated content from around the world
  • 📝 Smart summaries to save your time
  • ⚡ Clean reading experience, no ads
  • 📱 Responsive design for all devices

Our Mission

Making information accessible and digestible. AI works for you, not the other way around.
